shared_elements: shallow low-relief or engraved linear marks
tall upright rectangular field of decoration
horizontal registers or bands of markings
justification: Both are tall upright fields of shallow incision on coarse weathered stone, with markings loosely organised into horizontal bands, which is about the only correspondence. A, however, carries curvilinear figural/emblematic motifs (discs, rings, arcs, a masked head) in bold relief on a free-standing sculpted block, whereas B is a flat slab covered in fine, dense, repetitive script-like lines with no imagery at all.
